messages:
priya (AE): Hey team — TrustPath legal just asked for our SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert, and a signed pen-test letter for their POC. Can we pull together what we can share this week?
alan (solutions-eng): We have the latest SOC2 Type II PDF and ISO cert stored in compliance S3. I can package a redacted bundle.
priya (AE): Perfect — they also want a short note about our network isolation for POC (staging vs dedicated). Are there any blockers for giving them staging creds?
alan (solutions-eng): Staging creds fine, but if they need dedicated infra for the POC we need a procurement/commit (even short-term). For the note: we can say "POC runs in logically isolated staging; dedicated options available with reserved capacity."
jess (security): @priya quick heads-up: we don't sign pen-test letters pre-engagement. We provide a standard attestation/pen-test-letter-of-intent template that legal can use to request vendor testing. After we accept an engagement we sign the full letter once scope and timing are confirmed.
priya (AE): Understood. Can you drop the attestation template here? They'll likely push for something signed ASAP.
jess (security): Pasting the standard snippet below and will also upload the template to the secure share.
compliance-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/trustpath/2026-02-20/compliance-bundle.zip (expires in 7 days)
jess (security): Snippet:
"Redwood Inference confirms we maintain SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications. For third-party penetration testing, Redwood will coordinate in-scope testing upon execution of a testing agreement defining scope, timing, and responsible parties."
sam (sales-eng): For pricing: TrustPath asked about Dedicated POC cost if they want reserved GPUs for two weeks. Ballpark (internal): small Dedicated pool ~ $9k–15k / 2 weeks depending on size and region. I'll get exact quote.
alan (solutions-eng): I'll prepare a redacted bundle (SOC2 + ISO + short infra note) and put the pen-test intent template in the secure share. ETA: EOD today.
priya (AE): Thanks — can you also include a one-page checklist we can send to their security team listing what we need from them (network ranges, contact for pen-test coordination, expected dates)?
jess (security): small typo in name? (should be jess)
jess (security): On it — adding the checklist items: point of contact, preferred test window, allowed IP ranges, test methods to exclude (social engineering), and SLAs for notification.
priya (AE): Awesome. I'll draft an email to TrustPath once the bundle is ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
alan (solutions-eng): Bundle uploaded to s3 and secure-share link: https://secure.redwood.com/share/trustpath/abc123 (expires 7d). Included: redacted_SOC2.pdf, ISO27001_cert.pdf, pen-test-intent-template.docx, POC_infra_note.md, POC_checklist.xlsx
jess (security): Reviewed the bundle, redactions look good. Legal okayed the intent template but remind TrustPath we'll need a signed testing agreement before we sign final attestation.
priya (AE): Sending to TrustPath now with suggested timeline: bundle today, their review by end of week, sign testing agreement early next week, POC start week after. Will loop you in.
sam (sales-eng): LMK if they ask for dedicated pricing details — I'll attach the formal quote.
priya (AE): Will do. Closing thread once TrustPath acks.
